games.description: A solo descent through a research facility, mine tunnels, and the woods in the 2025 horror game. Sark collects keys and notes while repeatedly trying to get past a fast pursuer, then leaves the final forest search unfinished.
games.title: Descent

games.description: Four solo visits to the World War II stealth game. Sark repeatedly infiltrates the mansion, tests broken controls and the camera objective, tries the developer’s skip codes, and eventually reaches the rescue mission’s completion screen and repeats its final section.
games.title: Instruments of Peace

games.description: Sark opens the Slavic horror adventure and begins its introductory conversation. Severe capture and audio problems interrupt the brief attempt, leading to game-specific settings tests before he moves on.
